description: This file defines the 'Folder' class in a SuiteCRM module related to email folder management. It includes methods for retrieving folder data from the database, managing mailbox folder state, and interfacing with other system components like sessions and global variables. It serves as a model class representing email folder entities within the application.

classes.name: Folder
classes.description: Private model class for managing email folders, representing a fake SugarBean for list view data integration. Handles retrieval and state management of email folder data from the database.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Retrieves folder data from the database based on a folder ID, updating the object's ID, type, and mailbox properties.

methods.name: retrieveFromRequest
methods.description: Retrieves folder data based on request parameters and updates session state accordingly.

methods.name: loadMailboxFolder
methods.description: Loads mailbox folder information using request parameters, session data, or user preferences, and sets the current folder context.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of the folder (e.g., inbound).

methods.name: getMailbox
methods.description: Returns the mailbox name associated with the folder.

methods.name: isSelectedForDisplay
methods.description: Checks whether a folder ID should be displayed, using SugarFolder's criteria.

methods.name: getFirstDisplayFolder
methods.description: Retrieves the first folder suitable for display from the system.
